“CLOSED” NA LANDFILL.. PERO BUONG METRO MANILA ANG NILASON? PANANAGUTAN, TIANGCO!

May isang malinaw at hindi na kayang itago na katotohanan:

Kung “closed” na ang Navotas sanitary landfill…
bakit umaabot ang usok hanggang Makati at iba pang bahagi ng Metro Manila?

Hindi ito simpleng isyu ng sunog.

Ito ay usapin ng:

• public safety
• environmental compliance
• accountability ng liderato

At higit sa lahat.. kapabayaan.

Sa ilalim ng pamumuno nina Toby Tiangco at John Rey Tiangco, inaasahan ng publiko na ang isang “closed” landfill ay ligtas na.

Pero ang nangyari?

Mula “unhealthy” naging “acutely unhealthy” ang air quality.

Ibig sabihin: Hindi lang ito aberya.. ito ay banta sa kalusugan ng publiko.

Firm linked to Monterrazas de Cebu development faces public for first time

Mont Property Group faces the public for the first time on April 15, 2026 following months of backlash over alleged flooding linked to its controversial Monterrazas de Cebu development. General manager Camille Bondad said the firm came forward to address the controversy directly and insisted that technical findings backed the project’s flood-related claims. The group cited a University of the Philippines study, saying the watershed within the project area did not contribute to flooding in surrounding localities and that mitigation structures were in place. Last week, Vice Mayor Tomas Osmeña maintained his opposition to the project, saying ongoing construction and road works continue to influence water flow in Barangay Guadalupe. 

VIDEO BY KAISER JAN FUENTES

Lawmaker says constituents to continue protest unless 12% VAT is cut

Batangas 1st District Rep. Leandro Leviste says that the protest of his constituents will continue until his demand of decreasing the value added tax from 12 percent to 10 percent is met through a vote at the House of Representatives. Leviste also called on the Commission on Appointments to delay the confirmation of acting officials, including Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, whom Leviste accused of blocking his push to decrease the VAT. 

VIDEO BY RED MENDOZA
